nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Changes Rule
nodes.rationale: This repo's Next.js version differs from model training data, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code rather than relying on remembered conventions.

nodes.label: Frontend Work Gate
nodes.rationale: Frontend implementation must read FRONTEND_DESIGN_STANDARDS.md first; the exclusions recorded there are intentional and must not be re-added.

nodes.label: Migration 007 Auth Binding
nodes.rationale: Links people.auth_user_id to auth.users.id and owner-scopes profile/friendship/visit/companion mutations while preserving public profile reads and the public shared-plan flow.

nodes.label: No Legacy Identity Claim
nodes.rationale: A public legacy profile UUID is not proof of ownership, so a new authenticated profile copies only the cached display name/avatar and deliberately does not claim the old public identity or its history.

nodes.label: Email One-Time Code Sign-In
nodes.rationale: Email templates must render {{ .Token }} so the login UI can accept a six-digit code; a {{ .ConfirmationURL }} template still works through the /auth/callback link flow.

nodes.label: Google OAuth Provider Config
nodes.rationale: Google client ID/secret live in Supabase provider settings only; no Google secret belongs in the repository or in a NEXT_PUBLIC_ variable.

nodes.label: Public Supabase Environment Shape
nodes.rationale: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is temporarily accepted alongside the publishable key for compatibility with the existing local environment.

nodes.label: Progressive Pools Plan Format
nodes.rationale: Nine dealt places across three pools, one exclusive choice per pool, deterministic pool winners and deterministic final tie-breaking; older plans stay backward-compatible as one-round finals.

nodes.label: Saved Custom Places
nodes.rationale: Members pin up to three owned custom places with private/friends/community visibility; pinned places are explicit overrides and are never randomly drawn into other plans.

nodes.label: Related-Category Dealing Fallback
nodes.rationale: lib/deal.ts deals from related category families while preferring the exact requested category, because several exact catalog categories hold fewer than nine entries.

nodes.label: Budget, Origin and Radius Inputs
nodes.rationale: Affordability and travel become recommendation inputs: AED-per-person ceiling, starting area and 10/20/35 km or unrestricted radius, filtered before ranking using stored coordinates with Dubai-area centroid fallback.

nodes.label: Been Archive Collections
nodes.rationale: Been is organized as a named-collection archive rather than a flat grid; demo membership persists in localStorage until visit_collections and the private photo bucket from migration 010 are connected.

nodes.label: Luna Smart Search
nodes.rationale: A server-only route interprets natural Dubai requests into structured constraints, is prohibited from returning venue names, bounds every value server-side, requires a coherent-plan classification, and never exposes OPENAI_API_KEY to the browser; lib/deal.ts stays the source of truth for real venues.

nodes.label: Age-Aware Mainstream Catalog
nodes.rationale: Date of birth is collected privately, accounts must be 13+, venues use 18/21 thresholds, and the prohibited sexually-explicit-content rule is enforced at UI, API and database boundaries so the catalog stays suitable for a broad social app while nightlife remains allowed.

nodes.label: Secure Server-Side Plan Creation
nodes.rationale: app/api/plans/route.ts became the authenticated creation boundary validating account age, category minimum age, spot eligibility, custom-place ownership, prohibited venue text, nine unique candidates and deadlines, because a browser client could otherwise attach restricted spots directly.

nodes.label: Host-Token Plan Commands
nodes.rationale: Migration 015 replaced permissive plan/plan_spots transition policies with creator-scoped updates and a locked security-definer RPC so pool advancement, winner decisions and committed event edits are atomic and host-only.

nodes.label: RSVP Coming / Maybe / Can't Make It
nodes.rationale: Migration 016 adds a richer attendance choice while legacy boolean 'coming' rows stay valid and are mapped safely on read.
nodes.norm_label: rsvp coming / maybe / can't make it

nodes.label: Participant Token Seam
nodes.rationale: Per-plan random tokens are held in the browser and only their SHA-256 hash is written, an intermediate compatibility seam that keeps legacy name-only rows readable; tokens never appear in URLs or copy actions.

nodes.label: Participant Write RPCs
nodes.rationale: Migration 018 moved vote/RSVP/rating writes to security-definer RPCs and removed anonymous direct write policies; live invalid-token calls return 401 / SQLSTATE 42501.

nodes.label: Permissive Shared-Link Trust Model
nodes.rationale: Public shared-plan voting stays name-based and link-trusted on purpose so guests can vote without accounts; authentication secures profile/social ownership, not voting identity, and no stronger server enforcement should be claimed than exists.

nodes.label: Security Review P0/P1 Findings
nodes.rationale: Read-only review found host_token_hash leaking through public plan projections and realtime, participant RPCs missing relational/state validation, DOB metadata self-editable via saveBirthDate, non-transactional plan creation and process-local rate limits.

nodes.label: Social Place Link Import Feature
nodes.rationale: Pasting an Instagram/TikTok/Facebook/Reddit/YouTube or web link should return sourced venue details saved to 'Want to try' or 'Planning'; only URL validation and local preview persistence ship so far and the unfinished stages must not be claimed complete.

nodes.label: Populated Demo Account Views
nodes.rationale: Explanatory tab panels were rejected; every tab must behave like a genuinely used Dubai account so the end-to-end flow is visible at /home-preview without a real Supabase account.

nodes.label: Plan / Discover / Been / Friends / Profile IA
nodes.rationale: Photos and ratings stay contextual child views inside venue and visit surfaces rather than becoming top-level destinations that clutter navigation.
nodes.norm_label: plan / discover / been / friends / profile ia

nodes.label: Architectural Ivory / Graphite / Champagne System
nodes.rationale: Sleek modern Dubai read as contemporary architecture and hospitality, not black-and-gold cliché, neon or decorative luxury tropes; the landing/home design is the product-wide source of truth and the public vote flow was aligned to it without changing vote logic.

nodes.label: Persistent Day/Night Toggle
nodes.rationale: Stored under the deal-three:theme local-storage key and inherited by shared plan pages; night mode is obsidian/warm-white/champagne rather than glow-heavy.

nodes.label: No Green Glowing Status Lights
nodes.rationale: A permanent user preference: no green glowing dots or pulsing status lights anywhere, recorded in FRONTEND_DESIGN_STANDARDS.md so it survives future passes.

nodes.label: Plain Copy, Real Dubai Context
nodes.rationale: Pseudo-technical filler ('Live decision network', 'Signal active', model identifiers) was rejected; the product associates with Dubai through real neighborhoods, venues, activities and timing, and internal 'signal' field names were renamed so the terminology cannot return accidentally.

nodes.label: Planind Wrapped Recap
nodes.rationale: A local monthly demo recap with share/copy using the browser Share API and clipboard fallback; production aggregation over persisted plans, votes, RSVPs, visits and photos waits for account persistence.

nodes.label: Local-First Planning Layer
nodes.rationale: Shared lifecycle, circle, moodboard, reminder and memory types live in lib/planning.ts with versioned local-storage helpers so demo behavior maps cleanly onto persisted plans later; auth and Supabase persistence are deliberately deferred.

nodes.label: Multidimensional Place Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: The catalog must cover every hangout type, so a multidimensional place/experience taxonomy replaces continually extending one flat category enum; 23 plan types across five groups and eleven new functional categories were added.

nodes.label: Targeted Graphify Feature Workflow
nodes.rationale: Do not scan the full repository: query the Graphify index for the feature and data flow, open only the files needed plus the local Next.js docs, make the smallest coherent change, then update the checkpoint.

nodes.label: Verification Without a Test Runner
nodes.rationale: No dedicated test runner exists, so verification is ESLint, tsc --noEmit, the Next.js production build, git diff --check and live route checks; Playwright coverage is still recommended.

nodes.label: Web/PWA plus Future Native Scope
nodes.rationale: Native should use Expo/React Native with shared Supabase and domain logic rather than wrapping the Next.js UI in a generic webview.

nodes.label: Excluded Standards Sections
nodes.rationale: The original Product quality and Color sections were explicitly excluded by the user; every other recorded section is an active requirement.

nodes.label: No Green Glow Rule (Standards)
nodes.rationale: Status is communicated with clear text and restrained semantic styling instead of green glowing dots or pulsing lights.

nodes.label: Seven-Stage Resolution Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Intake, permitted source material, clue extraction, candidate generation, confidence resolution, enrichment/reconciliation, then present-and-save; the original post stays accessible even when resolution fails.

nodes.label: Allowlisted Provider Adapter Boundary
nodes.rationale: Each platform gets its own adapter preferring official APIs, embed metadata or user-supplied material; no generic server fetch endpoint exists and login walls or platform access controls are never bypassed.

nodes.label: Confidence-Gated Confirmation
nodes.rationale: High confidence enriches directly, medium shows two or three candidates, low asks for more information, and inaccessible posts move to needs_input instead of pretending a place was found.

nodes.label: Never Let an LLM Invent the Venue
nodes.rationale: The final result must correspond to a real catalog or place-provider identifier; failures stay recoverable and never silently become invented venue records.
nodes.norm_label: never let an llm invent the venue

nodes.label: Source Freshness and Claim Separation
nodes.rationale: Stable facts are stored separately from source claims because prices, hours, reviews, booking info and images change at different rates and each needs a source name plus retrieval timestamp.

nodes.label: SSRF and Untrusted-Input Rules
nodes.rationale: Credentials stay server-side; private IP ranges, unapproved redirect hosts, oversized responses and unsupported media are blocked; captions, page metadata, OCR and model output are all treated as untrusted input, and matching evidence is stored so corrections are auditable.

nodes.label: Screenshot Fallback
nodes.rationale: A user-supplied screenshot and caption is the universal fallback for private, deleted or region-restricted posts that no adapter can reach.

nodes.label: Migration 012 Place Import Tables
nodes.rationale: place_imports, place_collections and place_collection_items with owner-scoped RLS and automatic creation of 'Want to try' and 'Planning'; the endpoint deliberately does not yet fetch pages or persist imports.

nodes.label: First Provider Completion Criteria
nodes.rationale: A signed-in member pastes a supported public link, leaves, returns to see resolution progress, confirms a real Dubai place, inspects sourced details and keeps it in a default collection.

nodes.label: Group Decision Layer Positioning
nodes.rationale: Not a directory, invitation maker, calendar or booking marketplace: the moat is making a high-quality group decision across categories, not the number of categories.

nodes.label: Group Fit Score
nodes.rationale: Rank for the group rather than the loudest member or the creator, learning category/vibe, budget, travel tolerance, dietary and accessibility needs, timing habits, visit history and recent compromises, and explain each candidate succinctly.

nodes.label: Constraint-Aware Three, Never a Feed
nodes.rationale: Natural language becomes structured constraints returning three credible choices; the anti-feed is the feature because the product reduces choice instead of manufacturing more browsing.

nodes.label: Better Decision Protocol
nodes.rationale: Private preference capture before totals, ranked or yes/okay/veto choices, deal-breakers separate from preferences, deterministic tie-breaking, an optional decide-for-us mode, fairness memory, and a deadline that actually closes server-side.

nodes.label: Live Plan Resilience
nodes.rationale: The winner stays useful after the vote through availability and hours rechecks, travel and weather warnings, booking deep links, automatic fallback to option two, and reminders based on departure time rather than event time.

nodes.label: Web Guests, Native Regulars
nodes.rationale: The share link must stay excellent with no install or account so guests vote in seconds; the native app earns installation with saved groups, contacts/calendar, location, notifications and post-hangout memories.

nodes.label: The Memory Loop
nodes.rationale: Lightweight post-hangout feedback (went/skipped, worth repeating, actual spend, vibe accuracy, photos, attendance) feeds the next three options so the product compounds in value for a repeat group.

nodes.label: Recommended Delivery Order
nodes.rationale: Secure auth and no-install share voting first, then taxonomy, constraint capture, Group Fit Score, booking handoffs, saved groups, native client, and only then fallback monitoring and payments.

nodes.label: Strategy Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: Avoid an infinite venue feed, shallow category sprawl, forcing voters to register, another group chat, an AI chatbot as the whole interface, unlabeled paid placement in the decision score, owning booking inventory early, and a social feed before repeat planning works.

nodes.label: Trust-Preserving Revenue Paths
nodes.rationale: Affiliate revenue only after the winner is decided, premium concierge, venue tools, clearly labeled sponsored candidates that never secretly alter ranking, and group payment facilitation when operationally ready.

nodes.label: Migration Runbook
nodes.rationale: A single status table replaced prose scattered through checkpoints, which stopped being trustworthy at migration 014; migrations 002 through 019 are ordered, additive and re-run safe.

nodes.label: schema.sql as End-State, Not Update Path
nodes.rationale: schema.sql describes a scratch project's end state and now includes the RPCs it was missing, since a project built from the old copy could be read but never written to; setup.sql was deleted as a drifted subset.
nodes.norm_label: schema.sql as end-state, not update path

nodes.label: Smoke-Test Database Guards
nodes.rationale: npm run test:smoke asserts ten live guards: no host token in the plans projection, refused forged host-token and member_ages writes, and participant RPCs rejecting foreign spots, dead rounds, empty names and premature ratings.

nodes.label: Security Hardening Pass 2026-08-10
nodes.rationale: Every P0/P1 finding from the prior review was still open; each fix has the same shape — move a secret or a rule somewhere the client cannot reach.

nodes.label: Host Token Isolation (plan_host_tokens)
nodes.rationale: plans.host_token_hash was readable by any share-link visitor and broadcast over realtime, so it moved to an insert-only plan_host_tokens table with no select policy; patching individual select("*") calls was rejected because the next one would reintroduce the leak.

nodes.label: Participant RPC Integrity Validation
nodes.rationale: Migration 018 validated only a token-hash regex and never read plans; the hardening added spot-in-plan membership, plan status, stage/phase agreement, pool bounds, winner-only rating and non-empty names.

nodes.label: Write-Once member_ages DOB Record
nodes.rationale: DOB in auth user_metadata was rewritable by any signed-in browser, making the 13/18/21 gates self-certified; it now lives in member_ages written only by the write-once set_birth_date RPC, and safeAgeFromMetadata was replaced by memberAge() so no caller can read age from metadata again.

nodes.label: Legacy Direct-Write Path Removal
nodes.rationale: Three direct-write fallbacks in the shared plan page were revoked by migration 015 and failing silently (the decide fallback never checked its error); they and the duplicate client tally were deleted so execute_plan_command is the sole tally, and the deadline auto-pick became host-only.

nodes.label: Plan Creation Rollback
nodes.rationale: A failed plan_spots insert used to leave an unusable plan behind a live share link, so the plan row is now rolled back on failure.

nodes.label: In-Process Rate Limiter Gap
nodes.rationale: Deliberately still open: rate limiters are in-process Maps that reset on cold start and the OTP limiter grows unbounded on attacker-supplied emails; distributed limiting is future work.

nodes.label: Deferred Authentication Scope
nodes.rationale: Google OAuth is not enabled in the connected Supabase project (external.google: false), so product work should not block on external auth credentials; prioritize core planning, local/demo usage, recommendation quality, testing and security review instead.

nodes.label: Next-Agent Start Order
nodes.rationale: Read the handoff and CHECKPOINT.md instead of rescanning the repo, fix host-token exposure first, harden participant RPCs with negative tests, design the protected DOB record, then run the full verification set and update both logs.
